summary: On the hosted (non-self-hosted) app, when a logged-in host finalizes a poll and it is their 2nd+ finalized poll with 3+ participants, the finalize dialog shows a one-time founder-signed card asking for a G2 review; recorded via new users.review_requested_at column (migration) and PostHog events. The finalize success text no longer says 'Your event is booked for ...' / 'N participants will be notified', just the date.

statements.why: Runs inside the existing finalize mutation for ctx.user; claimReviewRequest never throws so finalize can't fail from it; additive nullable column.

statements.text: Most of this change is in a new file, review-request-card.tsx (84 lines added).
statements.why: New component rendering the review ask.
Founder photo shown on the card.

statements.text: The agent added wording in the app: "Dismiss", "Write a review", "Founder of Rallly" and 1 more.
statements.why: app.json adds reviewRequest* strings (and removes two finalize strings, unmentioned).

statements.text: The agent also changed finalize-poll-dialog.tsx, feature-flags/config.ts and trpc/routers/polls.ts, in ways plain can't describe yet.
Apply migration 20261005120000_add_user_review_requested_at to your live database before the new code goes live, or the parts that use it will fail.
statements.why: Adds users.review_requested_at; Prisma user queries expect it.

misses.what: What the feature actually does: hosts on the cloud app who finalize their second poll (with at least 3 participants) see a one-time card, signed by the founder, asking them to review Rallly on G2; it's recorded so it shows once per user, and views/clicks are sent to PostHog analytics. Off for self-hosted.
The finalize confirmation no longer tells the host how many participants will be notified (and drops the 'Your event is booked for' sentence); it now shows just the date.
